title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A shapeshifting planeswalker, Maralen's brother, who steals the dawnglow, saves Maralen with it and declines to stay and rule.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie queen, poisoned by moonglow and saved by dawnglow; she is no longer fully fae and sustains Rhys no longer.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf hunter whose life was sustained by his promise to Maralen; when it ends he thanks Eirdu and dissolves into petals.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The old faerie queen, creator of Oko and Maralen.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who heals Tam and leads the students home via Omenpaths.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker and professor who scolds Tam and is then confronted by a white-clad version of herself.

entities.name: White-clad Liliana
entities.description: A woman in a white gown who has Liliana's own face and arrives at her office to talk.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student who retrieves the dawnglow with Sanar and Lluwen and nicknames Lluwen Lulu.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin student who helps retrieve the dawnglow and cares for Tam.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon student from Shandalar who is healed after being shot.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who returns after being swept away and led Eirdu back to the battlefield.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf hunter who turned against Morcant and joins the students on Arcavios.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin and rimekin who tells Rhys he is a short-lived elf and who foresees the Mornsong sung again.

entities.name: Alandra
entities.description: A classmate from Shandalar whose father will help with the Omenpath passage.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The sun incarnation that arrives with Abigale, wrestles Isilu and restores the balance.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon incarnation that answers Eirdu, wrestles it and departs toward its cavern.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: River folk who guarded the sleeping Eirdu and traveled with Abigale.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: The kithkin of Goldmeadow who revert to their original states when the night recedes.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: The elf army that retreats after the elementals restore balance.

entities.name: Dawnglow
entities.description: The vial of Shadowmoor potion that counters moonglow poison and helps heal Tam.

entities.name: Moonglow
entities.description: The deadliest daylight poison that coated Rhys's knife.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The High Perfect whom Lluwen fears will kill him.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's palace where Oko will always have a home.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Tam's home plane, reached through a stable Omenpath, with a coastal road and another Omenpath to Arcavios.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The students' home plane, where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals between planes used to return from Lorwyn through Shandalar to Arcavios.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Liliana teaches.

events.summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
events.quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

events.summary: Kirol spots Abigale alive, flying beside Eirdu.
events.quote: But she's alive !

events.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen race back with the vial of dawnglow rather than greet Eirdu.
events.quote: We can do both,

events.summary: Oko takes the vial of dawnglow from Kirol and flies off with it.
events.quote: Oko barely seemed to move as he snatched it away.

events.summary: Oko demands Ajani save his sister and tells him the magic of the plane is fed by story and that only saving the queen will save Tam.
events.quote: The magic of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is fed by story,

events.summary: Oko vows not to fail his sister and drips dawnglow into Maralen's mouth.
events.quote: What a cruel world, to force one such as I to play the hero,

events.summary: Maralen revives, swallowing the dawnglow under her own power as the wound's petals turn to golden sap and then ordinary blood.
events.quote: This time Maralen swallowed under her own power, and her eyes fluttered open

events.summary: Oko tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
events.quote: You thought you were destroying a tyrant, and that, at least, I can respect.

events.summary: Oko gives the remaining dawnglow to Ajani for Tam's wound.
events.quote: He took the vial, tipping its contents out over Tam's wound

events.summary: Isilu and Eirdu answer each other's calls and, instead of fighting, wrestle in play; Maralen declares the balance is here.
events.quote: Then Isilu returned the bow and pounced.

events.summary: Eirdu breathes on Tam, flaring the dawnglow in her wound, and she wakes and embraces Sanar.
events.quote: and she sat up, coughing, only to fall down again as Sanar flung himself at her

events.summary: Abigale explains that the merrow guarded the sleeping Eirdu and that it followed her back to the battlefield to fix the imbalance.
events.quote: The merfolk realized it was moving to fix the imbalances

events.summary: The elementals' dance ends; Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
events.quote: As the ribbons of night unwound, the transformed kithkin returned to their original states.

events.summary: Maralen thanks Oko for returning and tells everyone the night elemental awoke because the strangers' dreams hurt it.
events.quote: The night elemental awoke because your strange dreams hurt it.

events.summary: Maralen forgives Rhys, but realizes his old promise is gone and he is no longer bound to her magic.
events.quote: Your old one—I can't feel it anymore. You're no longer bound to my magic.

events.summary: Rhys thanks Eirdu and Maralen, then dissolves into flower petals and dies.
events.quote: His body came apart in flower petals, dawnglove and moonglove and apple blossom

events.summary: Oko declines to stay and rule, but Maralen offers him a home in Glen Elendra.
events.quote: But I love my freedom too much to be confined.

events.summary: Lluwen slips away to follow Ajani and the students, fearing Morcant, and asks to come along.
events.quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

events.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
events.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

events.summary: Liliana scolds Tam and says she will not ask Ajani for another favor, calling Oko a bastard.
events.quote: Encounters with that bastard Oko rarely end that well for anyone but him.

events.summary: A white-clad woman with Liliana's own face arrives at Liliana's office and asks her to close the door for a conversation.
events.quote: Maybe close the door, dear. We need to have a conversation.

relations.quote: The 'lady' is my sister, Maralen of the Mornsong
This isn't how my little sister's story ends.
We both failed our mother-maker when we ran away.
You're my friend. You've always been there for me.

relations.note: Oko calls him betrayer of his sister but spares him.
relations.quote: You're already something you're not supposed to be, betrayer of my sister

relations.note: Liliana is Tam's professor and scolds her.
relations.quote: You are in so much trouble, young lady,

relations.note: Liliana asked Ajani for a favor to retrieve her students.
relations.quote: I'm not going to ask Goldmane for another favor

relations.note: Lluwen fears Morcant will kill him for helping the students.
relations.quote: that perfect lady is for sure going to kill him,

relations.note: Tam and Alandra are from Shandalar.
relations.quote: Tam and your classmate Alandra are from there

relations.note: The elementals wrestle in play to restore balance.
